title: A Requirement node record
description: A Requirement node record. Carries an identity, a kind and the digest of the requirement statement — never the statement itself (SEG-SREQ-018).

id.description: An absolute IRI minted at serialization time. Opaque: its parts are never split back out, because a part may itself contain the separator (ADR-0007).

seg:localId.description: The case-local stable identifier — the string that enters a hash preimage. The id above is its serialization, not a second identity.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest, lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters. SHA-256 is fixed for the whole graph, so the digest needs no algorithm beside it (ADR-0005).
